notices.text:
Due to the weather conditions and the rainfall recorded, and in agreement with the Local Municipalities, the following trails will be closed on Saturday, 7th November:

ORCO-VEZZI AREA: all trails in the area***
MELOGNO AREA: 176 Bric Merizzo – 179 Fast and Furious – 180 Isallo Extasy – 181 Revenant***
SPOTORNO AREA: 303 Express Bridge***
VADO LIGURE AREA: Rocca dei Corvi – 607 Pineta – 608 Guidone – 609 Guidone pt.2***
BARDINETO AREA: all trails in the area

*********************************************************************************************************************************

Please respect the closures indicated above. Thank you for your cooperation.
